findings.title: How close Locksmith gets to the final margin
findings.text: Locksmith misses the final margin by 12.58 points on average; the closing spread misses by 12.27, the opening spread by 12.34 (Locksmith on the same games: 12.53).

findings.title: Does the market move toward Locksmith?
findings.text: When Locksmith disagreed with the opener by 3+ points, the line moved its way before kickoff 56% of the time (correlation 0.26, 8,386 games). That is the sign of real information the opener had not priced yet.

findings.title: Spread at the opening line (cover model)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 44-54 (-14.1%, -14.0 units). The same bets at the closing line: -14.0%. They beat the closing number 40% of the time.

findings.title: Total at the opening line (cover model)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 2041-1682 (+4.6%, +173.5 units). The same bets at the closing line: +1.1%. They beat the closing number 53% of the time.

findings.title: Spread at the opening line (raw gap)
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 966-795 (+4.6%, +83.2 units). The same bets at the closing line: -0.5%. They beat the closing number 58% of the time.

findings.title: Total at the opening line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 2111-1795 (+3.2%, +124.1 units). The same bets at the closing line: -0.0%. They beat the closing number 49% of the time.

findings.title: Windy-game unders at the opener
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 709-570 (+5.8%, +74.5 units). The same bets at the closing line: +0.2%. They beat the closing number 61% of the time.

findings.title: Spread at the closing line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 440-416 (-1.8%, -16.0 units).

findings.title: Total at the closing line
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 164-169 (-5.9%, -19.9 units).

findings.title: Windy-game unders at the close
findings.text: Rules chosen each season from earlier seasons only: 444-390 (+1.6%, +13.6 units).
